Embed texts with the OpenAI embeddings API

Source: R/python.R
embed_texts.Rd

Texts longer than the model's input limit are split into chunks and their embeddings averaged with token weights; requests are batched (Python stage embed).

Usage

embed_texts(
  texts,
  model = "text-embedding-3-large",
  dry_run = FALSE,
  dir = tempfile("saereg_embed_")
)

Arguments

texts

Character vector.

model

OpenAI embedding model.

dry_run

TRUE reports the number of tokens and requests without calling the API.

dir

Run directory for the inputs and outputs (a new temporary one by default).

Value

A matrix, one row per text (unit length), or NULL on a dry run.
